Two pitfalls when scanning imported constants at this pin (Lean v4.31.0). First, ConstantInfo.value? returns none for a theorem unless allowOpaque := true (Lean/Declaration.lean:482), so a 'used by' scan must match .thmInfo t => t.value. Second, a skip filter on the prefix 'eq_' (meant for equation lemmas) silently drops real theorems such as eq_of_mem_of_curvesExtendOn: skip only eq_<digits> and eq_def.
